$comment: Experiment C9 - the table-style cascade: the 5x5 sweep, every flag set, the last third of the gallery and the default grid. Probe packages written by tools/ground-truth/model/tables/cascade/build-deck.ts, read by tools/ground-truth/model/tables/cascade/read.ps1 over COM and exported at 4 px per point, scored by tools/ground-truth/model/tables/cascade/analyse.ts.

encoding.shapes: one `rows`x`cols`/`mask` per slide, space-separated; `extras` holds anything else a slide says, by index, or in this file the key of it in `templates`; the style is the deck`s unless a slide names one
encoding.codes: base64 of raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) over every slide`s codes in order, `width` digits each, indexing `values`: per cell, row-major, its COM fill, COM text, COM sides in full decks and paint; then each grid edge, horizontal first, as a|b|descriptor
